editorial:
Imagine a night out at a gay bar in New York City that turns into a total nightmare. You have a crazy religious leader and his cult of followers who storm the place with one goal: to wipe out everyone they think is a sinner. It starts off feeling like a tense hostage situation, but things take a wild turn when their hate actually triggers something supernatural. You get to watch a group of strangers who would normally never hang out suddenly forced to team up to fight off a horde of zombies. It is a weird, bold mix of social commentary and old-school monster mayhem that keeps you guessing about what will happen next.

The action moves fast, and while some of the effects look a bit dated, they add to the campy charm of the film. You will love how the unlikely heroes step up to save the city, though some of the dialogue can be a bit over the top. If you enjoy movies that are both mean and funny, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the heroes realize the zombies are drawn to the hatred and violence of the cult. The main characters use the cult's own weapons and traps against them. After a big fight, the religious leader is killed by the very undead monsters he accidentally woke up. The survivors manage to escape the bar just as the sun rises, leaving the cult members to be eaten by the zombies.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves B-movie horror with a social twist.
